definitions.short: Achijah , the name of nine Israelites
definitions.full: H281. Achiyyah אֲחִיָּה אֲחִיָּ֫הוּ, (always, except where other form noted), אֲחִי proper name, masculine ( brother of Yah(u) , compare Phoenician חמלך brother of Milk, & especially אחתמלך sister of Milk , where אחת must be construct since מלך is a male deity; compare Carthaginian חתמלקרת Eut 213 ). 1 a priest 1Sam 14:3 , 18 . 2 Scribe 1Kin 4:3 . 3 Prophet 1Kin 11:29-30 , 12:15 ; 14:2 , 4 ; 15:29 ; 2Chr 9:29 ; 1Kin 14:4-5 , 6 , 18 ; 2Chr 10:15 (last five אֲחִיָהוּ ). 4 father of king Baasha 1Kin 15:27 , 33 ; 21:22 ; 2Kin 9:9 . 5 grandson of Hezron 1Chr 2:25 , or perhaps proper name, feminine , mother of preceding four, compare Be. 6 son of Ehud, of Benj . 1Chr 8:7 = אֲחוֺחַ , 8:4 . 7 one of David's heroes 1Chr 11:36 . 8 a Levite, David's time 1Chr 26:20 . 9 a chief man under Nehem . Neh 10:27 . 10 a Gadite 1Chr 5:15 ( אֲחִי ). 11 a man of Asher 1Chr 7:34 ( id .)
definitions.rootNote: or (prolonged) אֲחִיָּהוּ ; from 251 and 3050 ; brother (i.e. worshipper) of Jah;
